why: Sentence verified verbatim at whats-new/2026-w22.md:89 (the raw MDX escapes the dollars as \$10/\$50 and \$30/\$150; wording is otherwise identical, and the line is a self-contained three-sentence lede that does not reverse itself). The identifier half of the finding is also correct: unified-network-interceptor.ts:496-499 is exactly `if (!FEATURE_FLAGS.fastMode) return false; return typeof model === 'string' && model === 'claude-opus-4-7';`, and the doc comment at :493-494 still says 'Only activates for Opus 4.7'. The CONSEQUENCE is false, which is inert-worklist shape 3 (enforcement one layer up) plus shape 4 (wrong subsystem named). (1) Line :497 short-circuits on FEATURE_FLAGS.fastMode, which is a hardcoded `fastMode: false` literal in feature-flags.ts:182 — the ONLY non-getter in that object; every sibling flag (developerFeedback, embeddedServer, codexRuntime) is a getter reading a NESSY_FEATURE_* env override, and fastMode has none. `grep -rna FAST_MODE|FASTMODE` over packages/apps/scripts/docs returns only FAST_MODE_BETA, the beta string itself. So shouldEnableFastMode returns false for EVERY model, Opus 4.7 included; the model literal at :498 is unreachable, not a live discriminator that works on 4.7 and misses 4.8. (2) There is no 'fast toggle' to be silently inert: no /fast command, no setting, no IPC, no i18n key (the only 'fast' hits in en.json are the Guardian fast-model rows). /fast is a Claude Code CLI slash command; this fork drives the Claude Agent SDK, and NESSY_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CLAUDE defaults off. (3) Even with the flag flipped, the Anthropic adapter's fast-mode branch (:991-999) can never fire for a Claude session: the interceptor's only consumer is agent/backend/internal/drivers/pi.ts:290 via resolveInterceptorBundlePath, i.e. it Bun --preloads into the Pi subprocess (and the headless server's own process) only. packages/shared/AGENTS.md records this as a decision with a reason: 'The Claude SDK no longer runs under Bun (since 0.2.113 it spawns a per-platform native `claude` binary), so --preload is not available there. Features that used to live in the interceptor for Claude (rich tool intent, fast-mode override, MalformedBodyError validation, etc.) are Phase-2 work.' (4) 'Stale pin, not a policy decision' is therefore wrong on the record: both the hardcoded-off flag and the 4-7 literal date from the same baseline commit 845cf0a4 (2026-07-05), and no fast-mode UI has ever existed. Not one of the nine §3 owner decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md (no 'fast' hit in that file), but the Phase-2 deferral in packages/shared/AGENTS.md is an equivalent recorded decision. Incidental confirmation: claude-opus-4-8 IS a real MODEL_REGISTRY entry (config/models.ts:133) and claude-opus-4-6 remaps forward to it (:62), so the model-table half of the claim holds — it is only the fast-mode consequence that does not.
correctedState: Fast mode is not implemented as a user-facing feature in this fork at all. FEATURE_FLAGS.fastMode (feature-flags.ts:182) is a hardcoded `false` const with no env override — alone among that object's flags — so shouldEnableFastMode (unified-network-interceptor.ts:496-499) returns false for every model, and the `model === 'claude-opus-4-7'` literal at :498 is unreachable rather than a stale live pin. There is no /fast command, setting or i18n string. Independently, the interceptor that houses the fast-mode branch preloads only into the Pi subprocess (drivers/pi.ts:290) and the headless server process, never into the Claude Agent SDK's native binary; packages/shared/AGENTS.md records the Claude-side fast-mode override as Phase-2 work pending SDK hooks or a local proxy. The only real residue is documentation staleness: the comment at :493-494 and feature-flags.ts:181 still say 'Opus 4.7' and '6x pricing' where upstream now defaults fast mode to Opus 4.8 at 2x, and Opus 4.6 fast mode is deprecated. That is a comment to refresh whenever fast mode is actually built, not a live inert toggle.
